category: Application Library examples: ECAD Import Module
description: Ready-made, documented example simulations installed with the ECAD Import Module. Each lists its physics interfaces, couplings and study steps; solve one with comsol_run_example or adapt its Java build script.

tools.name: Importing PCBs — Creating Component Domains [ECAD Import Module example]
tools.description: Application Library example of the ECAD Import Module (Tutorials): Importing PCBs — Creating Component Domains. A ready model to start from for a similar simulation.
tools.usage: MCP: comsol_run_example("ECAD_Import_Module/Tutorials/pcb_import_components") to solve it, comsol_example_info("pcb_import_components", include_java=true) for its build script. COMSOL: File > Application Libraries > ECAD Import Module > Tutorials > pcb import components
tools.notes: Library path ECAD_Import_Module/Tutorials/pcb_import_components; model file 341.3 MB. Documented Java build script available (rebuild with comsol_run_example method='java'). Requires the module licence to open and solve.
